mapper.sql: id, agent_id, user_id, asset_code, asset_name, balance, frozen_balance, total_in, total_out, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_member_asset_account WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_member_asset_account (agent_id, user_id, asset_code, asset_name, balance, frozen_balance, total_in, total_out) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{userId}, #{assetCode}, #{assetName}, #{balance}, #{frozenBalance}, #{totalIn}, #{totalOut})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_member_asset_account SET balance = balance + #{amount}, total_in = total_in + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND asset_code = #{assetCode}

UPDATE dms_member_asset_account SET balance = balance - #{amount}, total_out = total_out + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND asset_code = #{assetCode} AND (#{allowNegative} = 1 OR balance >= #{amount})
